title: Wording and content clean-up
summary: Standardises Public Account and Staff Account wording, removes Cloudron from public pages, moves technical Admin content out of Staff, and keeps Staff Login in the footer only.
changes: Glossary and UI copy use Public Account(s), Staff Account(s), Public Profile(s), Client and Caller.
Admin People lists use /admin/public-accounts and /admin/staff-accounts, with 301 redirects from the old /admin/users filters.
Public pages no longer mention Cloudron; Staff Login remains available in the site footer for guests.
GitHub, Open an issue and Discussions links are Admin-only; staff get Report a problem for an internal APES CIC ticket.
Staff guide rewritten for non-technical users; Admin guide keeps plugins, modules, directory, API and webhook topics.
Automated glossary drift and public Cloudron content checks added to the test suite.
affected_areas: Auth landing and Staff Login footer
version_rationale: MINOR: visible labels, menu names, Admin URLs and public/staff page content change across the app (old URLs keep 301 redirects).
validation: Feature tests for glossary terms, Admin account URLs, Staff Login footer placement, Report a problem, glossary drift and public Cloudron absence.
Herd preview at https://myapes-account.test for public landing, help and footer Staff Login.
composer milestone:bump -- v0.73.0 --check and myapes:changelog-validate against origin/main.
known_limitations: Historic change-log entries and release notes may still mention older terms such as Public users or Cloudron.
Staff Login itself still names Cloudron, which is intentional.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release tag (v0.72.0). Old /admin/users bookmarks continue to work via 301s after this release; rolling back restores the previous labels and routes.
provenance: Milestone v0.73.0 Beta: Wording and content clean-up, Epic #861, pull request #986.
